content.what_it_is: MATLAB vessel-wave plotting script that loads eta_00001 to establish a unit-spaced grid (L2-L10), selects outputs 20 and 40 with matching second labels (L12-L13), then creates two stacked pcolor panels with fixed ±1.5 color limits (L21-L40).
entities: output directory fdir defined at L2
eta array loaded at L4 and reassigned at L24
initial grid dimensions n and m defined at L6
grid spacings dx and dy defined at L7-L8
coordinate vectors x and y defined at L9-L10
selected output vector nfile defined at L12
time-label cell array min defined at L13
figure dimensions wid and len defined at L15-L16
loop index num defined at L21
formatted suffix fnum defined at L23

params_defined.name: min
params_defined.range: one second label per selected output

equations.ref: x coordinates from initial eta columns
y coordinates from initial eta rows

unresolved: Cross-file shape assumption across L4-L10 and L24-L28: coordinates are derived only from eta_00001, but later eta arrays are not checked for matching dimensions before pcolor.
The independent nfile and min arrays at L12-L13 are indexed by the same num at L23 and L31 without an equal-length check; editing only one can cause an out-of-range min{num} access.
The variable min defined at L13 shadows MATLAB's built-in min function for the remainder of the script.
MATLAB pcolor at L28 ordinarily omits the final matrix row and column as colored faces; no compensation is present if full-grid coverage is intended.
